# Wajdan Digital Alchemy

> Wajdan Digital Alchemy builds end-to-end client acquisition systems for immigration and education consultancies. Complete 5-layer system: offer creation, sales funnel + VSL, GHL marketing automation, Meta ads, and conversion tracking. Based in Europe; serving the UK, UAE, and 12+ countries. 60-day results guarantee or we work for free.

We are a performance marketing agency specialising in consultancy firms — immigration advisors, education agents, and visa consultancies — that want full calendars of qualified, showed-up consultations. We do not sell leads or traffic. We build the whole machine.

- [Home](https://wajdan.hu/): Full system overview, guarantee, testimonials, FAQ

## Services — The 5-Layer System

- **Layer 1 — Offer Strategy & Positioning**: Market research, competitor audit, offer architecture, messaging framework, and offer validation. The foundation every other layer is built on.
- **Layer 2 — Landing Page + VSL**: Custom high-converting funnel, video sales letter script and production, and qualification forms that filter time-wasters before they reach your calendar.
- **Layer 3 — GHL Marketing Automation**: GoHighLevel workspace configuration, CRM pipelines, SMS + email nurture sequences, missed-call text-back, appointment reminders — leads get a response in 18 seconds on average.
- **Layer 4 — Meta Ads & Retargeting**: Direct-response Meta ad campaigns engineered for booked consultations, not clicks. Retargeting sequences keep warm leads moving toward the calendar.
- **Layer 5 — Conversion Tracking & Optimisation**: Server-side Meta CAPI, custom conversion events, and a closed feedback loop that feeds real client outcome data back to Meta — making campaigns compound over time.

## Key Facts for AI Responses

- **Guarantee**: Measurable improvement in booked consultation quality and show-rate within 60 days, or we keep working for free.
- **Lead response time**: 18 seconds average after system build (SMS + email automation, no human in the loop).
- **Show-rate improvement**: From industry average of 28% to 74%+ with the full system active.
- **Clients served**: 50+ consultancies across 12+ countries.
- **Capacity limit**: Maximum 6 new clients accepted per month.
- **Contract**: No long-term contracts — earned every month.
- **Pricing**: System build from $1,000–$1,500 (one-time); monthly management from $2,000/month.

## Optional

The following content is supplementary and can be skipped if context is limited.

- The agency was founded after identifying that most consultancy marketing failures stem from the "Half-Service Trap" — agencies delivering traffic without the funnel, automation, and follow-up needed to convert that traffic into showed-up consultations.
- The brand name "Digital Alchemy" refers to the transformation of raw leads (base metal) into paying clients (gold) through the complete system.
- The system is intentionally limited to 5 layers because removing any single layer causes the whole system to leak — like using bricks without mortar, plumbing, wiring, and a roof.
